lines: A package root carries code, so the package is imported as a whole:
validator: 137,754 B in 113 modules on the contacts-oca page, of which its root index.js is 4,487 B.
Importing the single module that is used instead of the package root lets the bundler drop the rest of the barrel.
A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
contacts-oca: 888 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 871 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 17 B.
contacts-main: 2,923 B beyond the first copy, @vueuse/core 1,933 B, generated by vite 674 B, @vueuse/shared 282 B.
contacts-admin-settings: 17 B beyond the first copy, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 17 B.
contacts-files-action: 691 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 674 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 17 B.
All 5 pages load the same 2 files: 2,103,968 B raw, 533,445 B gzip, 99.7 % of the smallest page (contacts-files-action, 2,110,021 B).
Inside: @nextcloud/vue 707,321 B, @nextcloud/dialogs 297,756 B, @vuepic/vue-datepicker 140,907 B, @vue/runtime-core 66,450 B, axios 51,882 B.
moment, 365,109 B on the contacts-main page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 29,477 B on the contacts-oca page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
1,239 B in 1 piece of 1 file have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
